show.title: Company
show.usageHint: Shown, not enforced. The plan limits have never been applied, and blocking today would change how companies that are already over them work — that is a decision for the business, not the code.
show.suspendWarning: Suspending locks everyone in this company out of the app immediately. Their data stays untouched.
show.reasonHint: Required, and kept forever in the audit trail. In six months this will be the only record of why.
show.billingNote: Billing is not connected yet. The Stripe identifiers are stored and shown here; charging runs through its own integration.

suspended.title: This company is suspended
suspended.body: Nobody in this company can use the app while it is suspended. Nothing has been deleted: the data is intact and comes back as soon as it is reactivated.
suspended.contact: Get in touch with Goliath Dispatch to sort it out.
